scope: Minimum-presentable stylized native reconstruction of Represa Stewart Vargas, assessed against photographed references in eight daytime and two night Blender offline renders. Criteria1-8 apply only to that native asset and static geometry; criterion9 and final application delivery remain unapproved.

criteria.name: Identidad y silueta
criteria.finding: Long low dam with a dense repeated concrete body and a narrow straight timber walkway; no arch-dam towers or unrelated generic bridge.

criteria.name: Coronamiento y caras inclinadas
criteria.finding: Crest view now shows water inside the upstream teeth; profile and obliques establish broad solid cheeks and genuinely recessed narrow channels, replacing the first version triangular-tile appearance.

criteria.name: Proporciones y altura variable
criteria.finding: The 120m-length/13m-maximum-height reference is used proportionally; exposed height declines toward the raised meadow. Eighteen modules are an explicitly approximate visual rhythm, not a measured count.

criteria.name: Pasarela actual
criteria.finding: Close walkway view shows reddish planks, long handrails, inclined repeated supports, wire mesh and short concrete supports. Historical cable posts are not mixed into this version.

criteria.name: Relación hidráulica y contacto
criteria.finding: Broad horizontal upstream lake, water inside crest recesses, six narrow active channels in the deeper sector and a lower continuous collector/outlet. The isolated runoff strips of V1 are gone. Static contacts were inspected visually and checked numerically; WebGL water motion is not certified here.

criteria.name: Terreno y orillas
criteria.finding: Wooded rocky abutment and opposite rising meadow are differentiated; a broad irregular reservoir and a lower outlet replace any pedestal/disc treatment. Trees, distant houses and shore vegetation remain deliberately simplified context.

criteria.name: Materiales y lectura nativa
criteria.finding: The native render distinguishes warm grey-brown concrete, reddish timber, fine mesh and dark calm lake from narrow falling-water strips. Surface weathering and vegetation are stylized; the offline materials and lighting do not validate the Three.js shaders.

criteria.name: Integridad nativa
criteria.finding: No conspicuous detached pieces, distorted body, floating spillway strips or reversed surfaces were found in the ten reviewed renders. Native night views keep the structure readable. The independent geometry check passed; actual runtime lights and interaction remain outside this scope.

criteria.name: Aplicación Three.js real y móvil
criteria.finding: Browser/Windows computer control was reported blocked by the primary agent because the active URL could not be verified; no UI work or bypass was attempted by this reviewer. No actual WebGL, mobile UI, shader animation or browser-console review was executed.

independentlyExecutedChecks.projectionCheck: five aspect ratios x three pan poses; arithmetic only, not browser evidence

limitations: Photograph-led proportional reconstruction, not a metric survey or hydraulic certification.
Module count, water flow, planting and surrounding houses are interpretive, not measured or species-exact.
The V4 offline water strips do not prove that animated foam, ripples and droplets look correct under Three.js.
The native night setup uses review lights; runtime floodlight appearance has not been visually verified.
The separate distant Ventorrillo wrapper and its final relative scale/placement have not been visually verified in the actual web scene.
remainingBeforeFinalDelivery: Reopen the actual journey with the verified asset in an authorized browser session.
Inspect and capture daytime and nighttime views, camera approach/pan/retreat, actual animated water/foam and shader behavior.
Inspect mobile and desktop with the full interface; confirm legibility, no cropping/overlap, and console errors absent.
Submit that real browser evidence for independent criterion9 review before marking the complete product approved.
